profile.headline: IBM Cloudant Infrastructure - Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Programmer who has worked freelance and with a number of startups over the last 10 years and across 12 time zones, with primary interests in Ruby on Rails, Amazon Web Services, and Debian/Ubuntu administration.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
In this position I have had the fun and excitement of running and growing a small SaaS company, and getting my fingers into every aspect of the business, from coding, server infrastructure, and system administration to business strategy, marketing, and customer support.  

Our company hosts version control systems (SVN, Git, Hg) and project management tools (Trac).  Tying together the diverse set of open source applications required has given me the opportunity to do significant coding in Ruby, Javascript, Python, Perl, PHP, and C.  We continue to increase our usage of a variety of Amazon Web Services as we scale up our service.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Performed Ruby on Rails and Amazon Web Services consulting for a number of companies.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Used Ruby on Rails and Javascript to develop the company's secure document management and file sharing service with a cutting edge user interface.  Deployed and maintained the service on Amazon Web Services.

positions.title: Director of Research and Development
positions.description: Developed custom C#.NET applications for customers.  Also developed internal applications to automate our web development processes.
